Automation & Integration Engineer (contract)

Company: Delivro (logistics SaaS)

Build the integration layer between our platform and third-party TMS/ERP systems.

- Python, REST & webhook integrations, Airflow
- Design ETL pipelines from partner APIs
- Own reliability: retries, dead-letter handling, monitoring

Requirements: Python, API automation, Airflow or similar orchestrator
Nice to have: n8n, Zapier architecture, Terraform

Engagement: B2B contractor, 15-25 h/week
Rate: $2,000 - $3,500 / month
Remote: EU timezones; overlap 10:00-18:00 CEST
No exclusivity; subcontracting: allowed with disclosure
AI tools: allowed
Application: apply via Djinni profile or write to ops@delivro.example
notes: C archetype positive; subcontracting explicitly allowed.
